title: Support the original work
lede: This site exists because Shikaku deserves to be read. The best way to honor it is to read and watch through official channels.
why: Every official read and view tells publishers and studios that short stories like this have an audience. That is what makes anthologies like Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 possible.
This fan site provides no full-chapter scans, pirate links, or video downloads. Official images appear only as review excerpts; to read and watch, use the links below.
